  100 # Poisons the target and decreases its Speed by 1 stage. (Toxic Thread)
  101 #===============================================================================
  102 class Battle::Move::PoisonTargetLowerTargetSpeed1 < Battle::Move
  103   attr_reader :statDown
  104 
  105   def initialize(battle, move)
  106     super
  107     @statDown = [:SPEED, 1]
  108   end
  109 
  110   def canMagicCoat?; return true; end
  111 
  112   def pbFailsAgainstTarget?(user, target, show_message)
  113     if !target.pbCanPoison?(user, false, self) &&
  114        !target.pbCanLowerStatStage?(@statDown[0], user, self)
  115       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
  116       return true
  117     end
  118     return false
  119   end
  120 
  121   def pbEffectAgainstTarget(user, target)
  122     target.pbPoison(user) if target.pbCanPoison?(user, false, self)
  123     if target.pbCanLowerStatStage?(@statDown[0], user, self)
  124       target.pbLowerStatStage(@statDown[0], @statDown[1], user)
  125     end
  126   end

  338 #===============================================================================
  339 class Battle::Move::GiveUserStatusToTarget < Battle::Move
  340   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
  341     if user.status == :NONE
  342       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!"))
  343       return true
  344     end
  345     return false
  346   end
  347 
  348   def pbFailsAgainstTarget?(user, target, show_message)

  350       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message

  352     end
  353     return false
  354   end

  356   def pbEffectAgainstTarget(user, target)
  357     msg = ""
  358     case user.status
  359     when :SLEEP
  360       target.pbSleep
  361       msg = _INTL("{1} woke up.", user.pbThis)
  362     when :POISON
  363       target.pbPoison(user, nil, user.statusCount != 0)
  364       msg = _INTL("{1} was cured of its poisoning.", user.pbThis)
  365     when :BURN
  366       target.pbBurn(user)
  367       msg = _INTL("{1}'s burn was healed.", user.pbThis)
  368     when :PARALYSIS
  369       target.pbParalyze(user)
  370       msg = _INTL("{1} was cured of paralysis.", user.pbThis)
  371     when :FROZEN
  372       target.pbFreeze
  373       msg = _INTL("{1} was thawed out.", user.pbThis)
  374     end
  375     if msg != ""
  376       user.pbCureStatus(false)
  377       @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
  378     end
  379   end
  380 end

  410 #===============================================================================
  411 # Cures all party Pokémon of permanent status problems. (Aromatherapy, Heal Bell)
  412 #===============================================================================
  413 # NOTE: In Gen 5, this move should have a target of UserSide, while in Gen 6+ it
  414 #       should have a target of UserAndAllies. This is because, in Gen 5, this
  415 #       move shouldn't call def pbSuccessCheckAgainstTarget for each Pokémon
  416 #       currently in battle that will be affected by this move (i.e. allies
  417 #       aren't protected by their substitute/ability/etc., but they are in Gen
  418 #       6+). We achieve this by not targeting any battlers in Gen 5, since
  419 #       pbSuccessCheckAgainstTarget is only called for targeted battlers.
  420 class Battle::Move::CureUserPartyStatus < Battle::Move
  421   def canSnatch?;          return true; end
  422   def worksWithNoTargets?; return true; end
  423 
  424   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
  425     has_effect = @battle.allSameSideBattlers(user).any? { |b| b.status != :NONE }
  426     if !has_effect
  427       has_effect = @battle.pbParty(user.index).any? { |pkmn| pkmn&.able? && pkmn.status != :NONE }
  428     end
  429     if !has_effect
  430       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!"))
  431       return true
  432     end
  433     return false
  434   end
  435 
  436   def pbFailsAgainstTarget?(user, target, show_message)
  437     return target.status == :NONE
  438   end
  439 
  440   def pbAromatherapyHeal(pkmn, battler = nil)
  441     oldStatus = (battler) ? battler.status : pkmn.status
  442     curedName = (battler) ? battler.pbThis : pkmn.name
  443     if battler
  444       battler.pbCureStatus(false)
  445     else
  446       pkmn.status      = :NONE
  447       pkmn.statusCount = 0
  448     end
  449     case oldStatus
  450     when :SLEEP
  451       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was woken from sleep.", curedName))
  452     when :POISON
  453       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was cured of its poisoning.", curedName))
  454     when :BURN
  455       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s burn was healed.", curedName))
  456     when :PARALYSIS
  457       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was cured of paralysis.", curedName))
  458     when :FROZEN
  459       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was thawed out.", curedName))
  460     end
  461   end
  462 
  463   def pbEffectAgainstTarget(user, target)
  464     # Cure all Pokémon in battle on the user's side.
  465     pbAromatherapyHeal(target.pokemon, target)
  466   end
  467 
  468   def pbEffectGeneral(user)
  469     # Cure all Pokémon in battle on the user's side. For the benefit of the Gen
  470     # 5 version of this move, to make Pokémon out in battle get cured first.
  471     if pbTarget(user) == :UserSide
  472       @battle.allSameSideBattlers(user).each do |b|
  473         pbAromatherapyHeal(b.pokemon, b) if b.status != :NONE
  474       end
  475     end
  476     # Cure all Pokémon in the user's and partner trainer's party.
  477     # NOTE: This intentionally affects the partner trainer's inactive Pokémon
  478     #       too.
  479     @battle.pbParty(user.index).each_with_index do |pkmn, i|
  480       next if !pkmn || !pkmn.able? || pkmn.status == :NONE
  481       next if @battle.pbFindBattler(i, user)   # Skip Pokémon in battle
  482       pbAromatherapyHeal(pkmn)
  483     end
  484   end
  485 
  486   def pbShowAnimation(id, user, targets, hitNum = 0, showAnimation = true)
  487     super
  488     case @id
  489     when :AROMATHERAPY
  490       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("A soothing aroma wafted through the area!"))
  491     when :HEALBELL
  492       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("A bell chimed!"))
  493     end
  494   end
  495 end
